name: run-product-feedback-loop
job: Run product feedback learning loop: private feedback and public reviews into source-preserving evidence, safe routing, validated action, truthful updates.

inScope: Universal private intake with consent and retention
Ingesting authorized feedback and reviews without flattening provenance
Classifying and deduping by underlying problem
Routing urgent signals immediately and closing loops with truthful updates
outOfScope: Stars, volume, or payer value dictating roadmap
Rebuilding support operations, refunds, or incident command

inputs: Product scope, feedback and review sources, and audiences
Privacy, retention, support, and safety owners
outputs: Source-preserving evidence clusters with denominators and owners
Validated product action with rollout and live outcome
failureSemantics: Provenance is never flattened; urgent security, safety, payment, or accessibility signals never wait on a learning queue; the classifier is never its own validator or promoter; no uncommitted feature or date is promised.

outcome.observable: Feedback and review signals become source-preserving evidence clusters with validated product actions, immediate routing of urgent signals, and truthful customer updates, with two independent artifacts for combined private and public review flows.
